description: Import a world pack from a JSON file (e.g. one written by export_world_pack) or inline JSON. The pack must pass the world-pack schema and validate_world_pack's checks. Refuses to replace an existing pack unless `overwrite: true`; pass `packId` to import under another id.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing pack with the same id (default false)

packId.description: Import under this id instead of the pack's meta.id (sets meta.id to match)

path.description: Path to the pack's JSON file. A relative path is read from the export directory, where export_world_pack writes.

name: import_world_pack
